source_refs.note: Chladni Plate: a main subheading of 14.11 Sharpness of Resonance, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 40-40.

blocks.text: Chladni plate resonance ki achhi misal hai aur standing waves ka pattern (naqsha) dikhati hai. Yeh aam taur par circular (gol) ya square (chaukor) metal plate hoti hai jo horizontal rakh kar ek vibrator par lagi hoti hai aur beech (centre) se upar neeche (transversally) hilayi jati hai (Fig. 14.22). Jab plate ko kisi resonant normal mode ki frequency par hilaya jaye to us ki surface (satah) par nodes aur antinodes ban jate hain.

blocks.alt: (a) Classical (purani) Chladni plate: central support (beech ka sahara) par chaukor plate, aik kinare se pakri aur doosre kinare par violin bow se bajayi jati, oopar sand shaker se sand (ret) girti; sand nodal lines ke jaal par jama hai. (b) Modern (nayi) Chladni plate: plate mechanical oscillator par, jise electrical signal input milta hai; shaker ki sand rings (chhalle) banati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.22: Chladni plates, (a) classical aur (b) modern (kitab ki Figure 14.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'as shown in Fig. (14.20)' likhti hai, lekin Chladni plate Fig. 14.22 mein hai; Fig. 14.20 damping ka graph hai.

Jahan nodes bante hain wahan plate nahi hilti, baqi plate apne poore amplitude se hilti hai. Yeh pattern dekhne ke liye plate par sand (ret) ki patli layer (tah) barabar chhirak di jati hai. Sand hilne wali jagahon (antinodes) se hat kar nodes par jama ho jati hai, kyun ke nodes stationary (ruke hue) hain.
